common_symptoms: shoulder pain, shoulder dislocation, limited range of motion
risk_factors: previous shoulder injury, genetic predisposition, age, gender (more common in males)
preventive_measures: proper technique during sports, strengthening exercises, regular stretching
diagnosis_challenges: nonspecific symptoms, difficulty distinguishing from other conditions
treatment_challenges: poor adherence to rehabilitation program, risk of infection after surgery
